description: This file defines the API functions and data structures for managing Dynamic DNS (DDNS) configuration within a C-based COSA Data Model library. It includes function prototypes for getting and setting DDNS parameters, performing validation, commit, and rollback operations, as well as managing multiple DDNS service entries.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for DDNS context.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_Validate
methods.description: Validates the DDNS configuration parameters before applying.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_Commit
methods.description: Commits the DDNS configuration changes.

methods.name: X_CISCO_COM_DDNS_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts the DDNS configuration changes.

methods.name: Service_DelEntry
